audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. the risk identity and Theorem 2 are invalid; Corollary 1 is not a valid high-probability bound; the stated mutual-information equivalence and monotonicity enforcement do not follow.
limitations: 0347-F1 — Counterevidence: The weaker inequality a/b<=exp(a-b) is valid for 0<a<=b<=1; Theorem1 support partition is valid for a consistently defined risk.
0347-F2 — Counterevidence: Dropping constants may define an optimization heuristic; it does not yield the claimed finite probability guarantee.
0347-F3 — Counterevidence: Actual cosine alignment may favor a non-permuted solution; it is not claimed to necessarily produce this counterexample.

0347-F4 — Counterevidence: README uses non-distributed adaptation; train_b_noddp.py:142 correctly resets source. Optional if_true_label defaults off and normal evaluation label access is not itself leakage.
0347-F5 — Counterevidence: Office count can be overridden; historical command/revision unavailable; implementation can legitimately use a surrogate if documented.
0347-F6 — Counterevidence: Table8 UNK40.5/HOS38.9 match prose; improvements are not reversed.

Counterevidence: Weaker exponential surrogate upper bound exists; support partition valid when one risk consistently defined. Treating full open-set divergence as infinite gives a vacuous bound rather than rescuing useful finite guarantee.

Counterevidence: A parameter-independent divergent prior term can be discarded for an optimization heuristic, not a finite PAC-Bayes guarantee. Risk sign mismatch does not affect zero-gap counterexample.

Counterevidence: Cosine alignment may prefer a non-permuted solution; counterexample targets claimed equivalence, not assertion that implementation must learn permutation. Mean objective alone cannot enforce pointwise monotonicity.

Counterevidence: README selects noddp, whose iterator reset is correct; if_true_label default0 confirmed config68. Unknown-index shape errors could stop some configurations; finding requires path reaching CE rather than claiming every distributed configuration leaks.
Counterevidence: Defaults can differ from historical overrides; surrogate choices can be legitimate if documented. No derived quantitative effect or historical benchmark invalidity.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
This import checks publication format and identity; it does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific review is pending; author adoption has not been requested.
